provenance: Captured 2026-10-12 from the pinned CLIs against a local deterministic recorder (loopback 127.0.0.1:32211, /tmp/resp-capture/recorder.mjs, never committed): synthetic text/tool SSE with fixed ids, no provider credentials, no live dispatch. Sanitized only: credentials and machine text replaced with fixed SENTINEL-* tokens (consistent id mapping); JSON types, field presence, tool schemas, argument structure and id relationships preserved. Scrubbed lengths are NOT required to equal original lengths. Raw captures stay outside the repo.
notes: Muse ran in an untrusted workspace (Agent delegation unavailable); the two initial shapes reproduce the UAT envelopes (94,624 / 64,400 bytes original).
Muse tools arrive as one namespace item ('muse' with 26 nested function tools); the CLI echoes calls as 'muse.<name>' and joins results by call_id (item id and call_id stay distinct).

Codex declares tools as an 'additional_tools' input item (custom/exec, clock/sleep, collaboration/* namespaces); flat function_call answers for nested tools are refused client-side ('unsupported call: ...') with a string function_call_output — the tool-result fixture records that real round-trip. A successful native tool execution needs the upstream-native call format and stays a live-qualification item.

Codex sends reasoning {effort, context}, text {verbosity}, include [reasoning.encrypted_content], prompt_cache_key and client_metadata telemetry on every request; instructions was absent from the probe.
Muse sends instructions, max_output_tokens 128000, reasoning {effort max, summary auto}, include [reasoning.encrypted_content] and prompt_cache_key on every request.
Vibe default sends model mistral-vibe-cli-latest (display alias mistral-medium-3.5) with 9 tools, temperature 1, streaming, plus parallel_tool_calls, reasoning_effort and metadata.
